name: Mamta Godara
summary:
Strategic HR Leader with 15+ years of experience driving people strategy for leading retail and fashion organizations across digital, e-commerce,
and brick-and-mortar formats. Expert in HR Business Partnering, talent strategy, organizational effectiveness, and large-scale transformation
initiatives. Demonstrated success in partnering with executive leadership to design scalable structures, optimize workforce costs, and enhance
employee engagement in fast-growing environments.
Known for building future-ready organizations through data-led insights, leadership development, succession planning, and culture stewardship.
Adept at navigating complexity, influencing stakeholders, and delivering high-impact HR solutions that accelerate business growth while
strengthening employee experience and retention.
